text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Birthday wishes from the<n>Mejiros?! Is this
what they call a<n>birthday bonus?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank Palmer. She asked that we<n>celebrate her
friend's special day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer was telling us about how<n>much she's
learned since meeting<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We hope you'll continue to be good<n>friends with
our Palmer—and us.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
OMG Palmer really is doing the most!<n>But I'm so
glad I met her too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And you guys too, we besties<n>now—waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm jealous of your energy.<n>Waheeey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel the Mejiros' dignified image<n>crumbling as we
speak...
